name: 46549-longprompt-gptoss120b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine.
architecture: sparse mixture-of-experts decoder, mxfp4 expert weights -- 36 layers, 128 experts with 4 active per token, alternating sliding-window (128) and full attention, 8 KV heads at head_dim 64.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=48, warmup 25%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 192 requests with a 3600 s safety cap. Seed static 46549.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, single turn: 8192 prompt tokens and 2048 output tokens per request, min == max on both, temperature 0. The engine tokenizes the rendered prompt, so the report shows a prompt count a few tokens above 8192.
purpose: A long-document analysis assistant for 48 concurrent users, writing multi-page answers from 8K-token briefs on one GPU.
launch:
model: openai/gpt-oss-120b
tensor-parallel-size: 1
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.95
moe-backend: triton

# Must be set: the checkpoint's own default context is 131072 tokens, which does not fit this
# card. The workload's worst case is 8192 prompt + 2048 output = 10240 tokens.
max-model-len: 16384

enable-prefix-caching: false
